test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
Direction: In the question below are given three statements followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the given statements disregarding commonly known facts.

Statements:

All Files are Delta.

All Delta are Pots.

No Pot is Bud.

Conclusions:

I. No File is a Bud.

II. No Delta is Bud.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f59aaa2176d4350162a964c428ae90204160e401f29558d7db05e8a483fd619.png] 

**__Conclusions__:**

I. No File is a Bud → **True** (as "All Files are Delta, all delta are pots and no Pot is Bud" given. So, no File can never be a bud, hence, true)

II. No Delta is Bud → **True** (as "All Delta are Pots and no pot is bud" given. So, no delta can never be bud it is definite, hence, true)

Hence, **"****Both conclusions I and II follow"** is the correct.
